title: The Legend of 1900 (bcSunday)
synopsis: A newborn baby is abandoned on a piano in the cruise Virginia, without parents nor nationality, he is given the name of the year he is found - 1900. 1900 soon develops a masterful skill over piano, with every note he plays, it touches the hearts of people on board, including the girl who is after all a passenger moving from one place to another, but who remains as an occupant in his heart. Winner of Best Original Score at Golden Globe 2000.

Winner of Best Original Score at Golden Globe 2000.
synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 由《星光伴我心》導演基斯比湯納度執導在不同人生階段觀看，都有不一樣的體悟！維珍尼亞號郵輪上，一名棄嬰被發現在鋼琴之上，沒名沒姓，無父無母，結果船員取名為他出生的年份 — 1900。這位一生不曾踏上陸地的天才鋼琴師，觸動了郵輪上的每顆心靈，每個聽過他演奏的人，都會被深深打動，還包括那位充當過客的她……金球獎最佳原創配樂得主。

cast: Tim Roth, Pruitt Taylor Vince, Mélanie Thierry
